Montar Opções Inline Keyboard
Consultar Métricas no InfluxDB
query:
from(bucket: "smart_city_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "medicoes_pluviais")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "lamina_agua_cm" or r["_field"] == "ocupacao_pct" or r["_field"] == "distancia_cm")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
